_doc: Table FORMATS the study tool knows, and where each lives in the Ignition web lobby. Captured 2026-09-07 from the live client (Chrome, logged in). The wrapper's go-to-er reads `path` to drive the lobby wizard; the detector reads `tableIframe` to name the format of whatever table is actually open. Selectors live in code (launch.py), not here.

stakes._doc: Project-wide stake enum (NL<bb in cents>). `label` is the exact dropdown text in the Buy-In modal; practice stakes are in practice chips and carry no $ sign.

lobby._entryDoc: the site's own poker-lobby entry: redirects into the client shell and settles on /poker-lobby/home. Used as the FIRST hop when the window has no lobby (a fresh sign-in lands on /headless/poker/casino-crossplay, from which the ?lobby= deep links never boot).

wizard._doc: Both sections show the same 'Start … Game' wizard: CARD GAME / LIMIT / NUMBER OF SEATS buttons (class `active` marks the choice), a PRACTICE MODE toggle (`.custom-toggle label` class switch-btn-on|off) and NEXT. The wizard REMEMBERS the last choice per section — set every field explicitly. NEXT opens the Buy-In modal: 'Select Stake' custom dropdown (li rows carry the stake label), MAXIMUM / MINIMUM / OTHER amount (OTHER is a text input in dollars), 'Wait for Big Blind' checkbox (ring only), TAKE MY SEAT (disabled until stake picked and balance covers the minimum), close = button.close-btn. In PRACTICE MODE the 6-seat button is disabled: practice tables are 9-max only.

observedStakeLists._doc: The dropdown rows seen per section x seats on 2026-09-07 (real money) and in practice mode.

buyInBounds._doc: Observed MAXIMUM / MINIMUM in big blinds. Practice Zone needs 2,500 practice chips minimum; a practice balance below that disables TAKE MY SEAT.

chronology: 2. section: left menu 'Cash games' (/poker-lobby/cash-game) or 'Zone poker' (/poker-lobby/zone-poker)
3. wizard 'Start Cash Game' / 'Start Zone Game': CARD GAME (HOLD'EM) - LIMIT (NO) - NUMBER OF SEATS (6|9) - PRACTICE MODE toggle - NEXT

4. Buy-In modal (inside the lobby iframe, over the wizard): Playable Balance -> Select Stake dropdown (li rows) -> Select Buy-In Amount: MAXIMUM $x | MINIMUM $y | OTHER (input#small-input name=otherAmount, pre-filled with the maximum) -> [Wait for Big Blind checkbox, ring only] -> TAKE MY SEAT (disabled until a stake is picked and the balance covers the minimum); Close = button.close-btn

5. a table tab opens: iframe /static/poker-game/?...playMode=real|fun&gameFormat=cash|zone&seat=6|9. Ring: quickSeat* params carry blinds + buy-in. Zone: blinds only in the table title, buy-in NOT echoed -> the modal amount is authoritative (goto records it as buyInSource=modal)
6. leave: .iconItem.close in the table iframe header (top right, real mouse click) -> 'Are you sure you want to leave this table?' -> YES

buyInModal.stakeInput: text input showing the picked stake label (random id)
buyInModal.amountInput: input#small-input[name=otherAmount] - dollars (practice: chips); pre-filled with MAXIMUM
buyInModal.presets: buttons 'MAXIMUM $x' and 'MINIMUM $y' (click = fill amount); the 'OTHER' button is active while typing

tableIframe._doc: Once seated, the client adds an iframe to /static/poker-game/ whose query string names the table exactly. These are the params the detector reads (identity params — user, txId, connectionUuid, tableId — are deliberately NOT read or stored).

params.gameFormat: cash | (zone value TBC on first real Zone seat)
params.seat: 6 | 9 — the table's seat count (NOT the wizard choice: practice ring returned 9 after choosing 6)
params.playMode: fun = practice; anything else = real money
params.gameTableUrl: /poker-lobby/cash-game | /poker-lobby/zone-poker — the section the seat came from

wsFrames.CO_OPTION_INFO: on table join: bblind, sblind (cents), maxSeat, gameType, real (1 = real money)

tableIframe.leave: table header X (top right) -> 'Are you sure you want to leave this table?' -> YES

formats.name: NL5 Ring 6-max Ignition (TEST)
formats._doc: TEST STAKE (Brady, 2026-09-23): the cheapest real 6-max ring table, for exercising the reader, answers and relay of the NL200 6-max strategy without NL200 money. Answers are the NL200 answers unchanged (the 6-max charts and postflop rake are fixed at NL200). Sizes round to the cent (a 2.5bb open is $0.12/$0.13), so expect more size-snapping than at NL200. Sessions are tagged test; the 6-max miss queue ignores them.

formats.name: Practice Ring Ignition
formats._doc: Practice chips, one stake (2/4), 9-max only (the 6 button is disabled in practice mode). Stakes recorded as detail, not identity.

formats.name: Practice Zone Ignition
formats._doc: Practice chips, one stake (25/50), 2,500 minimum — unusable until the practice balance is topped up.
